description: An alfresco outdoor dining scene photographed at golden hour sunset, set against a sweeping Mediterranean hillside landscape with whitewashed village architecture and vineyard terraces visible in the middle distance. The setting is under a series of arched black iron pergola frames that draw a graceful arc over the long dining table. The long banquet table is dressed in a crisp white linen cloth and set for a formal dinner party, with white ceramic charger plates on natural woven rattan placemats, folded white linen napkins, and crystal glassware. Down the center of the table run several cream stoneware vases holding loose arrangements of blush and dusty-rose garden roses mixed with fluffy pampas grass fronds in warm straw tones. The dining chairs are natural honey-blonde chiavari chairs with cream cushion pads. The golden sunset sky suffuses the entire scene in a warm amber-peach glow, warming the white linen, the pale stone and cream village architecture, and the dusty sage vineyard foliage. Warm glowing light radiates from overhead and illuminates the tabletop with soft pools of gold. Camera is at standing eye-level with a normal lens, shooting a three-quarter angled view down the length of the table from the near end, with slight downward pitch to capture the full table setting and the landscape beyond. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
